title: CRM Industry Risks
label: 12-Industry Risks
markdown:
# CRM Industry Risks

| Risk | Business impact | Control direction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AI-generated outreach or claims are inaccurate | Damages trust and may create legal or commercial exposure. | Retrieval-grounded drafts, approval thresholds, source display and human review. |
| Automated outreach violates local rules | Spam complaints, domain damage, fines or loss of sending privileges. | Consent/lawful-basis records, unsubscribe, suppression lists, country policies and frequency controls. |
| Cross-border data is misclassified | Personal or sensitive data may be transferred without a valid mechanism. | Separate enterprise and contact data, apply residency and transfer controls, and retain export evidence. |
| AI writes incorrect CRM fields | Pollutes pipeline, ownership or forecast data. | Confidence thresholds, suggested-not-automatic mode, audit history and rollback. |
| ERP and finance integration is underestimated | Delivery delays and low trust in revenue data. | Canonical data model, connector testing, reconciliation and staged rollout. |
| Mature vendors commoditise AI features | Generic AI positioning is quickly copied. | Defend with industry workflows, CPQ, order/collection linkage, data governance and ecosystem fit. |
